The trading business of the Group mainly involves the trading           集團之貿易業務主要是買賣中國進口之鐵礦

railways, industrial machineries, automobiles and home
appliances, etc.

instruments including iron ore futures/swaps to reduce the risks        以減低鐵礦石貿易業務所面臨的風險。本集團
faced by its iron ore trading business. The Group expects that          預期鐵礦石貿易業務之前景仍將充滿挑戰，並
the prospects of the trading business will remain challenging.          決定嚴格控制鐵礦石貿易風險，逐步減少鐵礦
As a result, it has decided to strictly control the risks of iron ore   石貿易收入及鐵礦石貿易量。
trading and gradually reduce the revenue from iron ore trading
as well as the volume of iron ore transaction.

      根據香港財務報告準則第5號，倘其賬面值主要通過
      銷售交易而非通過繼續持有而收回，該非流動資產
      及出售組合應分類為持有待售。分類為持有待售必
      須滿足的其中一項條件為極有可能完成出售。此外，
      持有待售資產應按賬面值與估計公平值減去銷售成
      本的較低者計量。

       Key Audit Matter                                           How our audit addressed the Key Audit Matter
       關鍵審計事項                                                     我們的審計如何處理關鍵審計事項
       Classification of and impairment assessment of investment in an associate – Shougang Century in relation
       to the Group’s planned disposal of interest in Shougang Century (continued)
       有關    貴集團計劃出售於一間聯營公司（「首長寶佳」）投資的分類及減值評估（ 續）
       (i)   Classification of investment in an associate –
             Shougang Century (continued)

             Given the disposal is subject to the approval of
             independent shareholders at a general meeting
             (the “General Meeting”) and the approval is not
             able to be ascertained or determined to be highly
             probable up to the report date, management
             determined that the criteria of HKFRS 5 were
             not met, as a result, the investment in Shougang
             Century as at 31 December 2018, had not been
             reclassified as an asset held-for-sale. Had the
             investment in Shougang Century been regarded
             as held-for-sale as at 31 December 2018, an
             impairment loss of approximately HK$205,200,000
             would have been recognised.

             We focused on this area since significant
             judgement was made by management in the
             classification of the investment in Shougang
             Century, specifically whether the requirements
             of HKFRS 5 had been met. In addition, had
             the requirements of HKFRS 5 been met, the
             reclassification and impairment losses involved in
             the planned disposal transaction would have had
             a significant impact on the consolidated financial
             statements of the Group.

       (i)   於一間聯營公司（首長寶佳）的投資分類（續）

             鑒 於 出 售 事 項 須 待 獨 立 股 東 於 股 東 大 會（「股 東 大
             會」）上批准，而直至報告日期仍無法確定獲批之可
             能性，管理層由此確定香港財務報告第5號之標準未
             獲 達 成，因 此，於2018年12月31日 於 首 長 寶 佳 的 投
             資未被重新分類為持作出售資產。倘於2018年12月
             31日於首長寶佳之投資被視為持有待售，則將確認
             一項約港幣205,200,000元的減值虧損。

             我們專注於此方面乃由於管理層於對於首長寶佳的
             投資進行分類時曾作出重大判斷，尤其是香港財務
             報告準則第5號之要求是否已達成。此外，倘香港財
             務報告準則第5號的規定已達成，計劃出售交易所涉
             及重新分類及減值虧損對 貴集團的綜合財務報表
             將亦有重大影響。

The PRC laws and regulations require companies registered in the                                    中國法律法規要求在中華人民共和國（「中國」，就本報
People’s Republic of China (the “PRC”, for the purpose of this report                               告而言，不包括香港，中華人民共和國澳門特別行政區
shall exclude Hong Kong, the Macao Special Administrative Region of the                             及台灣）註冊之公司從各自法定財務報表所呈報的淨溢
People’s Republic of China and Taiwan) to provide for certain statutory                             利（ 抵 銷 以 往 年 度 之 累 計 虧 損 後）中，於 分 派 溢 利 予 權
reserves, which are to be appropriated from the net profit (after offsetting                        益持有人前，劃撥款項以提撥若干法定儲備金。所有法
accumulated losses from prior years) as reported in their respective                                定儲備金均為特別用途而設立。中國公司於分派當年度
statutory financial statements, before profit distributions to equity holder.                       之除稅後溢利時，須向法定儲備劃撥淨溢利之10%。當
All statutory reserves are created for specific purposes. PRC company is                            公司法定盈餘儲備的總和超過其註冊資本之50%時，公
required to appropriate 10% of statutory net profits to statutory reserves,                         司可停止劃撥。法定儲備將僅可用作彌補公司之虧損、
upon distribution of its post-tax profits of the current year. A company                            擴大公司的生產營運或增加公司之資本。
may discontinue the contribution when the aggregate sum of the statutory
surplus reserve is more than 50% of its registered capital. The statutory
reserves shall only be used to make up losses of the company, to expand the
company’s production operations, or to increase the capital of the company.

          The Group’s policy is to recognise transfers into                                      本集團之政策為於報告期間結束
          and transfers out of fair value hierarchy levels as                                    時確認公平值層級之間的轉入及
          at the end of the reporting period.                                                    轉出。


          Level 1: The fair value of financial instruments                                       第一級級別：於活躍市場買賣之
          traded in active markets (such as publicly traded                                      金融工具（ 如公開買賣的衍生工
          derivatives, and equity securities) is based on                                        具及股本證券）之公平值乃根據
          quoted market prices at the end of the reporting                                       報告期間結束時的市場報價列
          period. The quoted market price used for financial                                     賬。本集團所持有之金融資產所
          assets held by the group is the current bid price.                                     用之市場報價為現時競標價。該
          These instruments are included in level 1.                                             等工具乃計入第一級級別。


          Level 2: The fair value of financial instruments                                       第二級級別：非於活躍市場買賣
          that are not traded in an active market (for                                           之 金 融 工 具（ 如 場 外 衍 生 工 具）
          e x a m p l e , o v e r- t h e - c o u n t e r d e r i v a t i v e s ) i s             之公平值以估值技術計算。該等
          determined using valuation techniques which                                            估值技術充分利用可獲得之可觀
          maximise the use of observable market data                                             察市場數據，從而盡量減少依賴
          and rely as little as possible on entity-specific                                      公司之特有估計數據。若按公平
          estimates. If all significant inputs required to                                       值計量之工具之所有重大數據均
          fair value an instrument are observable, the                                           可從觀察取得，則該項工具會被
          instrument is included in level 2.                                                     列為第二級級別。


          Level 3: If one or more of the significant inputs                                      第三級級別：若一個或多個重大
          is not based on observable market data, the                                            輸入數據並非根據可觀察市場數
          instrument is included in level 3.                                                     據釐定，則該項工具會被列為第

14   INVESTMENT PROPERTIES (continued)                             14    投資物業（ 續）
     Valuation processes of the Group (continued)                        本集團估值流程（續）
     At each financial year end the senior management:                   於各財政年度末，高級管理層：

     •      verifies all major inputs to the valuation;                  •      驗證估值的所有主要數據輸入；

     •      assesses property valuations movements when                  •      評估物業估值相較於過往年度估
            compared to the prior year valuation;                               值的變動；

     •      holds discussions with the internal valuation team           •      主持與內部估值小組及獨立估值
            and independent valuers.                                            師的討論。

     Valuation techniques                                                估值技術
     The Group obtains valuations for its investment                     本集團至少每年一次就其投資物業取得
     properties at least annually.                                       估值。

     At the end of each reporting period, the directors                  於各報告期末，董事均經考慮最近期估
     update their assessment of the fair value of each                   值更新彼等就各物業的公平值的評估。
     property, taking into account the most recent valuations.           董事於合理公平值估計範疇內釐定物業
     The directors determine a property’s value within a                 價值。
     range of reasonable fair value estimates.

     The best evidence of fair value is current prices in                公平值的最佳憑證為相類似的物業在活
     an active market for similar properties. Where such                 躍市場的當時價格。如未能取得有關資
     information is not available the directors consider                 料，董事則會考慮來自多方面的資料，
     information from a variety of sources including:                    包括：

     •      current prices in an active market for properties            •      不同性質的物業於活躍市場的當
            of different nature or recent prices of similar                     時價格或類似物業在比較不活躍
            properties in less active markets, adjusted to                      市場中的近期價格（ 須就反映上
            reflect those differences                                           述差異作出調整）

     •      discounted cash flow projections based on reliable           •      根據未來現金流量的可靠估計而
            estimates of future cash flows                                      預測的折算現金流量

     •      capitalised income projections based upon a                  •      根據物業估計市場收入淨額以及
            property’s estimated net market income, and a                       源自市場證據分析的資本化比率
            capitalisation rate derived from an analysis of                     而預測的資本化收入。
            market evidence.

     There were no changes to the valuation techniques                   年內，估值技術並無變動。
     during the year.
